summary: fix(content-server): restore 404 page styles, remove dead build config
description:
Because:

- FXA-14816 deleted the webpack config, the only build step for main.css.
- The 404 page loaded main.css and showed without styles after a fresh build.

This commit:

- Restyles 404.html with Tailwind utilities and shared fxa-react classes.
- Copies only tailwind.out.css in copy:styles.
- Deletes the SCSS sources, style-guide page and route, and jquery-modal.
- Deletes sourceMapType, webpackModeOverride, pocPairingRoutes and two dead grunt tasks.

Closes FXA-14828
